premise: The wind blows Butterfly away from Flower; Deer lets her ride on his nose and walks her slowly all the way back.
inspiration: The folk tale of the leaf carried off by the wind, turned: a gentle giant carries the small one home against it.
lesson: Being big means you can carry someone small home.

en-US.title: Butterfly in the Wind
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly loved to visit {flower:enter} Flower {flower:pulse}. Every morning she landed on her petals and said hello. But today, {canvas:wind 0.8 16s} {sfx:gust} whoosh! A big wind came blowing through the meadow. [surprised] Butterfly {butterfly:spin} tumbled up, up and away, over the grass and past the trees. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] Flower! she called. I can't get back! {deer:enter} Deer {deer:pulse} was standing at the edge of the meadow. {deer:face happy} [softly] Land on my nose, he said. Hold on tight. So Butterfly held on. And Deer walked, very slowly, very carefully, into the wind. {deer:pulse x2} Step… by… step, all the way back across the meadow. When the wind had gone, Deer bent his head down low, {flower:face surprised} till his nose touched Flower. {butterfly:face happy} {flower:face happy} [happily] Hello, said Butterfly. {flower:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} I came the long way round. {deer:glow}

es-ES.title: Mariposa y el viento
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} A {butterfly:enter} Mariposa le encantaba visitar a {flower:enter} Flor {flower:pulse}. Cada mañana se posaba en sus pétalos y le decía hola. Pero hoy, {canvas:wind 0.8 16s} {sfx:gust} ¡fiuuu! Un viento fuerte entró soplando en el prado. [surprised] Mariposa {butterfly:spin} salió volando, arriba, arriba, lejos, por encima de la hierba y más allá de los árboles. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] ¡Flor!, llamó. ¡No puedo volver! {deer:enter} Ciervo {deer:pulse} estaba en la orilla del prado. {deer:face happy} [softly] Posa en mi nariz, le dijo. Agárrate fuerte. Y Mariposa se agarró. Ciervo caminó muy despacio, con mucho cuidado, contra el viento. {deer:pulse x2} Paso… a… paso, cruzando todo el prado. Cuando el viento se fue, Ciervo bajó la cabeza, muy bajito, {flower:face surprised} hasta que su nariz tocó a Flor. {butterfly:face happy} {flower:face happy} [happily] Hola, dijo Mariposa. {flower:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} He venido por el camino largo. {deer:glow}

gust.prompt: a sudden soft gust of wind sweeping through a meadow of long grass
